features: ADX is now rendered in the existing 30-day DMI panel as a Pine-style stepline using the ADX values already produced by analysis_core.py
ADX step segments are green (#26A69A) when ADX rises versus the prior day, red (#EF5350) when ADX falls, and neutral gray when flat
A new live/hover dominance capsule summarizes DI controller plus ADX direction: bullish/bearish control with strengthening or weakening trend strength
DI+ remains yellow, DI- remains purple, and the white dashed 20 axis remains a reference only
No Python calculation changes were required because analysis_core.py already computes Pine-equivalent ADX and get.py already emits ADX in chart_30d
